<!-- pr-reviewer: 6a15b91ddea217e7d0060308575990eba7566aaa -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The page is good, but four product claims do not agree with the tree. The issue says that each product claim must match what CamCraft ships.

This is a docs-only PR. It is not a SAFETY-tier review: the diff changes no posted G-code, no check, no simulation and no geometry. It changes no `crates/ui` code, thus no screenshots are necessary.

## What is good

- The page has all 14 sections of #4053. The guide index and `machines.md` link to it. The glossary has the new terms.
- The machine and post pairs agree with the `controller.post` values in `assets/machines/` for the Tormach 770MX microARC 4, the 1300PL, the three AltMill sizes, the Haas VF-2, the Fehlmann Picomax 55 and the LinuxCNC file.
- The file-format table agrees with the importers: `.sc` / `.solidcraft`, STEP, STL and OBJ load, and `.f3d` is refused by name (`crates/app/src/geometry/import/native.rs:14`).
- `import_svg` is an MCP tool and a script verb, and `crates/ui` has no SVG import. The sentence about the missing menu item is correct.
- The tool-library formats (`.camtools`, PathPilot `.csv`, Hurco `.TCM`) agree with `crates/app/src/tool_table.rs` and `tools.md`.
- The "do not share" list agrees with the Clean-Room Protocol.
- The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #4053`. The commit subject is conventional. The diff changes no process file.

## Results, trial-merged with main

Base: upstream/main `83d52ef6a`. The trial merge is clean. All work was local.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with `upstream/main` | clean |
| `zola build` / `zola check` | **not run**: this session cannot start `zola`. The author's reading is 52 pages, 0 orphans. |
| Internal links, checked by hand | pass: each `@/` target file exists, and each anchor matches a heading (`#machine-file-and-post-what-each-one-answers`, `#machine-and-post-pairs`, `#design-files-native-and-neutral`, `#the-five-steps`, `#at-the-machine`, `#place-a-dxf-profile`, `#setup-sheets`, `#post-processors`) |
| Cargo build, tests, clippy | not applicable: the diff has no Rust code |
| Heavy lanes, light lane, example catalog | not applicable: the diff reaches no code |

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no import code.

## Requested before merge

Class of all four findings: a product claim that does not agree with the tree. One rule closes the class: compare each row and each bullet of the page with `posting.md` (the table at lines 22-49), `machines.md` and the `.mch` files, and remove what has no source there.

1. `site/content/guide/model-to-machine.md:142` - "it shows the moving machine in the simulation". CamCraft does not do this. `camcraft_sim::machine_model` (#2584) has no caller in `crates/app` or `crates/ui`, and no guide page describes it. Remove the clause, or name what ships: **Show work envelope** draws the machine travel as an outline (`machines.md:75`).
2. `site/content/guide/model-to-machine.md:208` - the Control cell of the Sodick ALC400G row says "Mark 21". `machines.md:240` says: "The ALC400G control has not been confirmed to match the Mark 21 post." The machine file states no `controller.post`, and `posting.md:45` says to select the post manually. Write the cell and the state to agree with those two pages.
3. `site/content/guide/model-to-machine.md:61` - the Router row names the Makera Carvera. `makera-carvera.mch` declares `"kind": "mill"`, and `machines.md:22` lists the Carvera under Mill. Move it to the Mill row, or remove it from the Router row.
4. `site/content/guide/model-to-machine.md:207` - `tormach-pcnc*.mch` includes `tormach-pcnc440.mch`. That file states the Tormach PathPilot post, and `posting.md:30` lists it under PathPilot. The Mach3-era templates are the five PCNC 770 and PCNC 1100 files (`posting.md:39`). Name those files or those two models.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `model-to-machine.md:139` - "Which post it uses by default." `controller.post` is optional, and CamCraft offers the post but does not set it. "Which post CamCraft offers for it, when the file states one" is more exact.
- `model-to-machine.md:65` - the Wire EDM row sends the reader to "Machine and post pairs" for the posts. That table has only the Sodick row. The `wire-iso.cps`, `g-edm.cps` and `agie-native.cps` posts are only in `posting.md`. A link to `posting.md#post-processors` is more complete.
- The page is the only page directly in `guide/`. `guide-nav.html` lists the pages of the subsections only, thus the sidebar does not show the page. The guide index and the home card show it. This is acceptable if it is intended.
- Run `zola build` again on the fixed head and give the reading in the PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the four findings of the review of head `6a15b91dd`. The new head is `74831cc7cd194b5e07fa6d4e21b1f7cb66519768`.

The class rule is applied as tests. Three tests in `crates/app/tests/docs_troubleshooting.rs` compare the page with `assets/machines/*.mch` and with the post table of `posting.md`.

1. **Moving machine in the simulation.** The clause is removed. The page now names **Show work envelope**, which draws the machine travel as an outline. Pin: `model_to_machine_claims_no_moving_machine_in_simulation`.
2. **Sodick ALC400G row.** The Control cell says "Not confirmed. The post is written for Mark 21 / EX21." The State cell says to select the post manually, and that the control is not confirmed to match the post. Pin: `model_to_machine_pairs_agree_with_posting_and_machine_files`. A machine file without `controller.post` must have "Select the post manually" in its State cell.
3. **Makera Carvera.** It is now in the Mill row and not in the Router row. Pin: `model_to_machine_kinds_agree_with_machine_files`. Each shipped machine that the table names must be in the row of the `kind` of its file.
4. **`tormach-pcnc*.mch`.** The Mach3 row names the five PCNC 770 and PCNC 1100 files. Mach4 has its own row with "None dedicated". Pin: `model_to_machine_pairs_agree_with_posting_and_machine_files`. It refuses a glob, and each named file must be in the `posting.md` row of that post.

Mutation check: with the page of head `6a15b91dd`, the three tests fail. With only the Sodick row reverted, test 2 fails on the State cell. With the fixed page, all 5 tests of the binary pass.

Two notes of the review are also applied:

- Line 139 now says "Which post CamCraft offers for it, when the file states one."
- The Wire EDM row links to `posting.md#post-processors`.

The sidebar note is not changed. The guide index and the home card show the page.

Gate on the new head, base `upstream/main` `267ee5096`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 1 step, `app suites: docs_troubleshooting`, ok.
- Clippy on `camcraft-app --test docs_troubleshooting` with `-D warnings`: clean.
- `zola build`: **not run**. This session cannot start `zola`. The fix adds no new link target.

The PR is a draft again for this push. Please review the new head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 74831cc7cd194b5e07fa6d4e21b1f7cb66519768 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** All four earlier findings are fixed. No blocking finding remains.

### Earlier findings

I checked the earlier review and the author's `Addressed:` comment. Commit `74831cc7cd194b5e07fa6d4e21b1f7cb66519768` fixes each finding:

1. **Fixed: moving machine claim.** `model-to-machine.md:141` now describes **Show work envelope** as an outline. Test `model_to_machine_claims_no_moving_machine_in_simulation` passes.
2. **Fixed: Sodick control claim.** The ALC400G row states that the control is not confirmed. It instructs the user to select the post manually. This agrees with `machines.md`, `posting.md` and the machine file. Test `model_to_machine_pairs_agree_with_posting_and_machine_files` passes.
3. **Fixed: Carvera kind.** The Carvera is in the Mill row, as `makera-carvera.mch` specifies. Test `model_to_machine_kinds_agree_with_machine_files` passes.
4. **Fixed: Mach3 glob.** The row names the five PCNC 770 and PCNC 1100 templates. Mach4 has a separate row. The pairs test passes.

The post-offer wording and the Wire EDM link also address the earlier notes. The guide index and `machines.md` link to the new page.

### Local results

Rules: current `upstream/main:AGENTS.md`. Base: `aef12fea67e0082e7ba835a3d9fcade8e2c11eb0`.
Trial merge: `66580330a18ba721aab44638f0306ba4985410e0`. Its first parent is the full PR head above. The merge is clean.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Pass: 1 step, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| `app suites: docs_troubleshooting` | 5 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test docs_troubleshooting -- -D warnings` | Pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Pass |
| `zola build` | Pass: 52 pages, 0 orphans, 10 sections |
| `zola check --skip-external-links` | Pass |
| `zola check` | Same external-link failure on the PR and bare upstream/main; see below |
| `git diff --check upstream/main HEAD` | Pass |

Both full Zola checks report one failure in the unchanged `guide/reference/windows-troubleshooting.md`:

```text
https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/download-center/home.html
Client error status code (403 Forbidden) received
```

I ran the same command against the site from bare upstream/main. It fails on the same URL with the same status. This is a pre-existing failure and does not block this PR.

All builds and tests ran locally. An older Cargo process holds the original target lock. The local checks used `target-review-local` inside the review worktree, with sccache disabled. The review changed no source files.

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no fixtures, import code, posts, operations, motion or catalog. No recorded program or golden changed. The light and heavy lanes cover no changed runtime code here.

Safety tier: not applicable. The diff changes documentation and documentation tests. It changes no posted G-code, gouge or collision check, stock simulation or geometry. Mutation re-runs are not required and were not run. No `crates/ui` change requires screenshots. No dependency or process file changed.

Requested before merge: none.

The review worktree and branch remain in place for the next round. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
